newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add reserves via term system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add reserves via term system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Thursday through multi-day system system repurchase agreements, analysts said.
Patricia Thrapp, vice president at Aubrey G. Lanston & Co, said she expects the Fed to address its add need via four- or seven-day system repurchase agreements.
"The desk should be in with a term system repo to cover the add need," agreed analysts at MMS International. "Treasury deposits at the Fed are high at over $12.8 billion."
Rising Treasury deposits at the Fed drain reserves from the banking system.
At midmorning, Federal funds were trading at 5-5/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
(( -- Ellen Freilich, North American Treasury Desk 212-859-1679 ))
